title: Ties of Trust: a bowtie model to uncover trustor-trustee relationships in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating user perceptions and concerns regarding political bias in LLMs and human validators (e.g., data journalists) by having participants interact with an LLM-based political discourse analysis tool that classifies polarization and sentiment in political speeches.

Measuring users' predispositions and biases toward AI (such as over-reliance or algorithmic aversion) by comparing their accuracy assessments of political text analyses when informed the results were generated by ChatGPT alone versus validated by human experts.
